title: OwnerQuestion
description: One row of `GET /questions` (the owner-questions inbox): an open question read from a v2 spec's "Open owner questions" table (`source: spec`, `ref` = the hexagon, `qid` = `Q<n>`) or an open conventions conflict (`source: conflict`, `ref` = the conflict id, `qid` = `conflict`), joined with the owner's saved draft answer. `draft`, `acceptedRecommendation` and `draftUpdatedAt` are null until the owner saves a draft; `draftSentDemandId` is null while the draft is unsent. `stale` is true for a draft whose question is gone from the files.

ref.description: The hexagon name (spec) or the conflict id (conflict).

qid.description: `Q<n>` for a spec question; the word `conflict` for a conflict.

context.description: The context the question was asked in: a conflict's note; null for spec questions.

date.description: The spec table's "Date opened" cell, as written; null when absent.

produces.description: The spec table's "Decision it would produce" cell, as written; null when absent.

draftSentDemandId.description: The id of the demand that carried this draft to the vault; null while unsent.
